content.text:
I submitted index 0 (Pb 0.76 / Sb 0.24), which had the highest EQE I measured: 0.0049%. EQE is low everywhere I measured in this library.

| Index | Pb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.76 | 0.0049 |
| 4 | 0.66 | 0.00092 |
| 9 | 0.48 | 0.00089 |

- **Phases from XRD (4 of 5 scans used):** the Pb-rich samples (indices 0, 4 and 8) fit best to Pb₂Sb₂O₇, with a similarity of about 0.76 at index 4. At index 13 (Pb 0.34) the pattern looks mostly like PbSb₂O₆, but that match was only 0.51, so the identification is tentative.
- **Why I left the Sb-rich side unmeasured:** I expect PbSb₂O₆ to have a band gap too wide to absorb much of the 2.4 eV light. That is an assumption, not something I measured.
- **Main uncertainty:** with only 3 merit measurements, the Pb-rich end was the obvious guess. Index 0 is about five times better than the other two, but the Sb-rich half of the library has no EQE data at all.
